book.title: Castaway's Journal
pages:
I woke up on the beach
with no memory of how
I got here. My raft
is in pieces.

I need to rebuild it
to escape this island.

OBJECTIVE

Rebuild the raft by
collecting 3 resources:

🪵 Wood ×5
🪢 Rope ×3
⛵ Sail ×1

Then return to the
wreckage and escape!

WHERE TO FIND

🪵 Wood
Chop trees in the forest
with SPACE

🪢 Rope
Open crates on the
opposite beach

⛵ Sail
Defeat the skeleton boss
in the rocky zone

CONTROLS

WASD / Arrows — Move
SHIFT — Sprint
SPACE — Attack
E — Use item
F — Deliver to raft
Q — Raft log
1-8 — Hotbar
ESC — Pause

TIPS

Eat food to restore
hunger. Drink water
for thirst. Sprinting
costs energy.

Dying loses 90% of
materials. You get 1
extra life per run.

DELIVERY

When you have the
resources, return to
the raft (at the dock)
and press F to deliver.

When everything is
complete, press E
next to the raft
to ESCAPE!
